name: Godrej Industries
about: Godrej Industries Ltd. is a leading Indian conglomerate with businesses spanning consumer goods, real estate, agriculture, chemicals, and financial services. It operates through several subsidiaries, including Godrej Consumer Products, Godrej Properties, and Godrej Agrovet. The group serves over 1.1 billion consumers globally, with a market capitalization of USD 27.5 billion. Godrej Industries has a strong legacy of innovation and sustainability, being involved in producing household goods, real estate development, agriculture solutions, and chemicals. The company is committed to inclusive growth and environmental responsibility through its Godrej Good & Green and diversity initiatives, shaping a sustainable future.
